locator.title: Готовитесь к беременности? Узнайте, что нужно учесть
locator.lead: Даем простые советы, как улучшить здоровье, и рассказываем про комплекс Фемибион®
locator.caption: Создайте вечерний ритуал, например, за полчаса до сна выключите гаджеты, примите душ и проветрите спальню. Такие привычки помогут улучшить качество сна [11]

nearest_text_before.text: Специалисты рекомендуют будущим родителям соблюдать режим сна: ложиться до 22:00 и спать не менее 8 часов [10]. Это помогает организму восстановиться, а также нормализовать выработку мелатонина и других важных гормонов.

image_reading: A couple lies asleep together in a neatly made bed, close and relaxed beneath white bedding.
Their closed eyes, still posture, soft linens and quiet bedroom setting support a calm, restorative mood.
analysis.article_context: Body image under the section “Наладьте режим дня”: it illustrates a calming evening ritual and restorative sleep as part of preparing for pregnancy.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Restful, regular sleep supports wellbeing while preparing for pregnancy.
structured_intent.primary_action: The sleeping couple breathes slowly together, gently moving the duvet.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Both people remain peacefully asleep as the duvet settles softly in the final frame.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: A calm, restorative sense of shared rest is maintained throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, show one continuous cycle of calm shared breathing: the duvet and shoulders make a gentle, slow rise and fall while both people remain asleep. Keep the camera fixed on the couple. The motion eases naturally near the end, leaving the duvet settled and both faces relaxed in the final frames.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The sleeping couple breathes slowly and calmly as the white duvet rises and falls softly, then settles into a still, restful final frame with both remaining peacefully asleep.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, their slow breathing creates a subtle shared movement through the duvet and upper bodies from the opening moment onward. Maintain a fixed intimate framing and an even, unhurried rhythm. Let the final breath subside near the end so the last frame clearly holds two peacefully sleeping partners.
models.positive_prompt: The couple rests asleep, breathing slowly together; the duvet softly rises and falls and gradually settles, ending with both peacefully asleep in quiet stillness. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: Use the four seconds for a focused, gentle breathing motion: a soft rise of the duvet followed by an unhurried fall. The camera remains fixed, with no gestures or facial interaction. By the end, the bedding has settled and the couple remains visibly asleep in the same calm, restorative state.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the sleeping couple. Their calm breathing gently lifts the duvet once and lets it settle, ending with both still peacefully asleep and the bedding at rest.
